title: fix(spec): the packageless-overlay-write-closed upgrade entry names both closed overlay write addresses
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8WDoJDMZf2EGw5BXNyAhGUU)_
Fixes #29393

Clause-②: no (migration entry prose; no accept set moves)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只改文字。未发布的升级条目 `packageless-overlay-write-closed`(ADR-0087 语义迁移)的 `surface` 与 `reason` 现在同时点名两个被关闭的覆盖写入地址:不带包的写入,和点名只读基础包本身(`?package=基础包`)的保存、发布、回滚,并点名这两种写入各自存下的行;`replacement` 补上绑定在基础包上的行的迁移与处置(与 CLI 打印的一致)。
- 为什么改:#28905 在同一版本里关闭了第二个地址,但这条升级条目只写了第一个;升级指南由它生成,运维读不到第二个地址。来源:合同复核记录 6577747588 的 S3。
- 风险与回滚:无运行时改动,只影响生成的升级指南与 spec-changes 文字。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` 的 `surface`(两个编号地址)、`reason`(新增两句)与 `replacement`(绑定行的 `foreign_declaration` 处置)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:upgrade-guide`,预期 exit 0;用 `--out` 生成的指南里该条目出现 `naming the read-only package itself` 与 `publish-drafts`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

Text only, one entry. `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.packageless-overlay-write-closed.ts` (unreleased ADR-0087 semantic entry, shipping in the same release as the two closes):

- `surface` now names both closed addresses onto a view, dashboard, report, translation or email template an installed read-only package ships: (1) the write naming no package, worded as before; (2) the write naming the read-only package itself: a save in draft or publish mode or a per-item publish with `?package=BASE`, `POST /api/v1/packages/BASE/publish-drafts` holding such a draft, and a rollback of a row bound to the package, where the pair can be ensured, the base records a version and the override write gate admits the declared body (a delete naming the package keeps the write). The stored-rows clause now covers both: package-less rows, and rows bound to the read-only package itself (the rows `os migrate packageless-overlays` also moves since #29392).
- `reason` gains two sentences: what each address stored (a row of no package, which no export carries; a row bound to the package, declaring nothing, served in place of its own document), and the named close (refused `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` naming the pair and the `overrides` declaration where the pair can take the declared override; a delete naming the package stays open, and so does every write the pair could not take, an email template locale the base does not ship among them). Everything else in `reason` is unchanged.
- `replacement` (claim amendment 6584492790): the movable rows `--apply` moves are package-less OR bound to the read-only package itself (the preview's "bound to", `--json` `boundToBase`, which the ceremony lists and moves since #29392). An unmoved package-less row keeps its package-less write; an unmoved bound row keeps its delete naming the package. A bound `foreign_declaration` row gets the remedy the cli prints (`reasonOf`, the `boundToBase` arm, in `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/packageless-overlays.ts`): delete it naming the package, then save its body into the pair, declaring `overrides`, since a save naming the package is closed; the package-less remedy is unchanged. The failed-move tail: a bound row keeps its delete naming the package, and the save naming it where the pair could not take the override (for those two causes `namedBaseCloseSubject` answers null). The TO both closes share (write into `BASE.custom`, declaring `overrides`) is unchanged. `acceptanceCriteria` is untouched.
- The header comment above the entry names both closed addresses and both kinds of stored row.
- `.changeset/29393-overlay-write-entry-both-addresses.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, both declaration lines, one sentence each for `surface`/`reason` and `replacement`.

Measured against the code on `origin/main` (399df5bb): `namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal` / `namedBaseCloseSubject` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-packaged-base-refusal.ts`, and the #28905 changeset's Now refused / Still open lists, which the new wording follows clause for clause.

### The card's conditional line (commit revert path)

The card says to add a line if the S1 card decides the commit revert path stays open. The S1 card is #29390; its seat ruling (comment 6579511992) is fork **A**: the revert's restore limb is closed with the same sentence, so the path does not stay open. No such line is added. #29390 has no PR yet; when it lands, its own ADR-0087 disposition decides whether this entry's address (2) also names the commit revert and package rollback.

## Why

Contract review 6577747588 of PR #29270, should-fix S3 (the dev's open question 1, answered A): the upgrade guide is generated from this entry, and a reader should meet both closed addresses in one entry. Triage 6582524180 set p1: it lands before the 18.3.0 cut.

## Tests

No test pins this entry's text (`git grep` for the entry id hits only the entry and two changesets). The checks that read it, on b99d86a1:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/migrations scripts/upgrade-guide-docs.test.ts scripts/upgrade-guide-surface-span.test.ts` under the lock, after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (VERDICT command-exit 0): Test Files 7 passed (7), Tests 226 passed (226), VERDICT command-exit 0 (also 226/226 on 6b1ea514 and ecf1fd4a).
- `check:upgrade-guide` exit 0 (protocol 18.0.0, 2 hop sections); `check:spec-changes` exit 0.
- Generated with `tsx scripts/build-upgrade-guide.ts --out` to a scratch file: the entry renders as one surface code span holding both numbered addresses; `naming the read-only package itself` 2 hits, `publish-drafts` 5 hits, `boundToBase` 1 hit, `ship the name): delete it naming no package` 1 hit, `and the save naming it where the pair could not take the override` 1 hit.

## Acceptance notes

- No checked-in artifact regenerates from this entry: the upgrade guide and `spec-changes.json` are generated in memory at PR time and at publish (`build-upgrade-guide.ts` header), and the docs pages are gitignored.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates on ecf1fd4a (b99d86a1 is a prose-only follow-up in the same file)</summary>

- Prerequisite builds under the lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build` (VERDICT command-exit 0); `turbo run build --concurrency=2` over the objectql, lint, formula, client and client-react closures (VERDICT command-exit 0, 38/38 tasks).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` re-derived on ecf1fd4a: 76 families (2 paths vs merge base 399df5bba, +50/-19). Each run once, stdin from /dev/null, exit captured before any pipe: 75 exit 0 (the teardown self-test after its pinned fixture `621a4876` was fetched on the first round).
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: exit 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: 68 workspace packages unbuilt). NOT MEASURED locally; CI runs it on a full build.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 76 derived, 75 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (dual-build, from its recorded exit 3), 0 UNRUN.
- `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event` with this body: exit 0; LEVEL AXIS reads `Clause-②: no` + `Metadata-protocol: none`, patch.
- On b99d86a1 (the review's three text fixes, same file): spec build, the migrations and upgrade-guide tests (226/226), `check:upgrade-guide` and `check:spec-changes` exit 0. The derived set is a property of the changed paths, which did not change.
- `check:dev-prereqs` (local-only family): exit 1, the workspace is not fully built (68 of 106 packages); a reading of this container, not of the diff.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic (prose only).
- [x] 2. No name added.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. Patch changeset with both declaration lines, here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: no checked-in artifact regenerates from this entry (the guide and spec-changes are generated in memory at PR time).
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. English.
